items.exampleEn: A new office was set up to regulate the use of river water.
items.exampleZh: 新成立的單位負責管理河水的使用。

items.exampleEn: Rape is a serious crime under the law.
items.exampleZh: 在法律上，強暴是嚴重的罪行。

items.exampleEn: The presidency of the student council is open to all third-year students.
items.exampleZh: 學生會會長一職開放給所有三年級學生參選。

items.exampleEn: Every child is entitled to a safe place to learn.
items.exampleZh: 每個孩子都有權在安全的地方學習。

items.exampleEn: The teacher looked into the allegation that some students had copied homework.
items.exampleZh: 老師查證了「有些學生抄作業」這項指控。

items.exampleEn: In social studies, we learned about the legislative branch of government.
items.exampleZh: 社會課上，我們學到政府的立法部門。

items.exampleEn: It is hard to enforce a speed limit on such a long, empty road.
items.exampleZh: 在這麼長又空曠的路上，很難落實速限。

items.exampleEn: The online game company found that some players had won prizes by fraud.
items.exampleZh: 那家線上遊戲公司發現，有些玩家靠詐欺手段贏得獎品。

items.sentenceEn: Teachers at our school strictly enforce the rule about phones in class.
items.sentenceZh: 我們學校的老師嚴格執行上課使用手機的規定。

items.audioEn: As a member, you are entitled to free parking and a ten percent discount.
items.audioZh: 身為會員，你可以免費停車，還享有九折優惠。

items.sentenceEn: The city regulates the number of taxis on its streets.
items.sentenceZh: 市政府管制街上計程車的數量。

items.sentenceEn: The singer said the allegations against him were completely false.
items.sentenceZh: 那位歌手說，針對他的指控完全不實。

items.stemEn: Under the new law, ____ cases will be handled by specially trained police officers.
items.stemZh: 根據新法，強暴案件將由受過專門訓練的警察處理。

items.stemEn: The bank lost millions because of ____ by one of its own managers.
items.stemZh: 那家銀行因為自家一位經理的詐欺而損失數百萬。

items.passageEn: Last month, a local newspaper reported an allegation that a popular online shop was selling fake designer bags. The city's consumer office began to investigate. They found clear signs of fraud, and the shop was fined. The case started a debate in the community about how to regulate online shops. Some people said the city should simply enforce the rules it already has, while others asked for new laws. Our teacher used the story in class and explained that every customer is entitled to honest information about what they buy. She also told us that while she held the presidency of a consumer club in college, the club's legislative team wrote rules for the fairs on campus.
items.passageZh: 上個月，一家地方報紙報導了一項指控，說一家熱門網路商店在賣假名牌包。市政府的消費者保護處開始調查。他們找到明確的詐欺跡象，那家店被罰了款。這個案子在地方上引發了一場關於該如何規範網路商店的討論。有些人說，市政府只要執行現有的規定就好；另一些人則要求制定新法。老師把這個故事拿來上課，說明每位顧客都有權得到關於商品的真實資訊。她也說，她大學時擔任一個消費者社團的會長，當時社團的立法小組為校園市集訂定了規則。

questions.questionZh: 消費者保護處調查後發現了什麼？
老師說每位顧客有什麼權利？

items.promptZh: 這張會員卡讓你可以免費進入博物館。
referenceEn: This membership card entitles you to enter the museum for free.
With this membership card, you are entitled to free entry to the museum.
rubricZh: entitle 的用法，例如 entitle someone to…、be entitled to… 等

items.promptZh: 這座城市開始嚴格執行禁止亂丟垃圾的規定。
referenceEn: The city has started to strictly enforce the rule against littering.
The city has begun enforcing its rule against littering strictly.
rubricZh: enforce 指執行規定（例如 enforce the rule 等）
時態可用現在完成式或過去式（例如 has started、started 等）
strictly 位置不扣分；「亂丟垃圾」可寫，例如 littering、dropping litter 等
